description: Check a supplier's bank-detail change before the vendor record is touched: returns no_change, verify_first, stop or invalid_new_account with call-back steps. It never says an account is safe. Free, no token.

ibanOnFile.description: The account currently on the vendor record.

newIban.description: The account number in the change request, as written — spaces and dashes are fine, e.g. "DE89 3704 0044 0532 0130 00".

supplierCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country where the supplier is established, e.g. BE.

name: check_payment_change

evidence.description: Signed decision evidence, present when a signing key is configured.
